verdict.rationale: Radar exposes REST API endpoints (rules, value lists, reviews approve/decline) and has dedicated testing docs with test card numbers for automated fraud-rule verification, and Stripe ships an official CLI — all of which support headless/CI use. However, there's no explicit CI/automation guide, and a community report explicitly flags 'lack of easy programmatic control' as a pain point for adjusting Radar decisions. missing for 10: dedicated CI/headless workflow documentation, explicit automation examples, and resolution of the programmatic-control complaint.
